visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a middle-aged woman wearing a white wide-brimmed hat, glasses, and a white sleeveless tank top. She is standing outdoors in front of a tree adorned with numerous white prayer papers tied to its branches. She smiles and points her finger upward while speaking to the camera. (2) As she continues her monologue, the camera maintains a medium close-up shot with slight handheld movement. Her facial expressions are animated and friendly. Yellow and white text overlays pop up periodically near her. (3) The scene cuts to a clean, gray-toned graphic background displaying the logo 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' in black. Below the logo, contact information including a Line ID, phone number, and two address locations in New Taipei City and Taipei City are clearly listed in Chinese and English.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins with high clarity and a friendly, upbeat tone, speaking over a cheerful acoustic-pop background music track featuring piano and guitar. The environment sounds clean with minimal room tone. (2) As the speaker discusses her travel arrangements, short 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects are introduced as auditory markers for text overlays. The music maintains a constant 110 BPM tempo. (3) The vocal delivery remains consistent in energy, with complex intonation as she poses a question to her audience. No crowd noise or significant incidental noise is present. (4) The audio ends with the music swelling slightly into a clean resolve as the speech stops, coinciding with the transition to a brand information graphic.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Narrative Setup -> Opinion Query -> Contact CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a personal brand-building vlog for a dermatology clinic owner. By sharing a story about her employee trip to Okinawa and asking followers for their opinions on workplace benefits, she creates an approachable persona. The final screen provides concrete clinic contact details, converting viewer engagement into potential business leads.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Continuous presence of the clinic logo and a dedicated information slide at the end with addresses and phone numbers.
